source_of_truth: frontend/src/styles/global.css (:root) — verified, not a generic framework palette
identity: Industrieel energielabel: papierwit + inktzwart + hazard-geel + koper; mono voor data. Editorial, technisch, research-led. Geen blauwe SaaS-look, geen cartoon, geen glossy gradient, geen willekeurige stoplichtkleuren.

typography.note: SVGs name the brand fonts first with system fallbacks (no external font required).

self_consumption_policy.meaning: quantified self-consumption / avoided import / policy effect

trading_flexibility_and_secondary_compon.meaning: potential incremental day-ahead/onbalans/flex value; and the secondary component (avoided feed-in cost) in the waterfall

engine_result.badge: paper fill, 2px solid ink border, mono text 'ENGINE RESULT'

scenario_overlay.badge: paper fill, 2px DASHED ink border, mono text 'SCENARIO-OVERLAY — …'
scenario_overlay.meaning: must look different from an engine result

accessibility_rules.grayscale_safe: every classification also uses labels/patterns/shape — never colour alone
accessibility_rules.text_contrast: ink on paper/volt; volt_dk for yellow text on light; paper text only on dark cells
accessibility_rules.svg_a11y: role=img + unique <title> id + unique <desc> id + aria-labelledby; responsive viewBox (width=100%); no external scripts/fonts/images
accessibility_rules.sequential_scale: paper -> pale volt -> volt -> ink (monotone luminance; no blue/rainbow)
